item.title: Pembroke Lumber Kings soar over Hawkesbury Hawks 8-3
item.description: Mathis-Quy Lavallee with two goals and an assist helped pave the way for an 8-3 Pembroke Lumber Kings victory over the visiting Hawkesbury Hawks Sunday night. A crowd of 399 took in the action at the Pembroke Memorial Centre, and went home happy after a lopsided Lumber Kings win, only the team’s ninth victory of the season. item.title: Pembroke advocates for city's needs with Ontario government
item.description: City of Pembroke council and staff have been pressing the province on a range of local priorities, using several recent opportunities to bring the city’s concerns directly to senior decision-makers. item.title: Ottawa Valley Community Foundation opens grant application process
item.description: The Ottawa Valley Community Foundation has opened its annual grant application process, inviting eligible charities and community organizations to apply for funding to support local needs. Registered charitable organizations have until March 20, 2026, to submit full applications as part of the Foundation’s yearly granting cycle. item.title: BIRDWATCH: Rare Red‑headed Woodpecker spotted in the Ottawa Valley
item.description: On Jan. 11, 2026, Heather Ball of Wilson Road informed me that she had had a Red-headed Woodpecker in her yard for a few days. This is one of our more attractive woodpeckers that unfortunately, only visits us occasionally. The last sighting of this bird in our area that I am aware of was back on July 15, 2020, on Sandy Beach Road. Around that […]

item.title: Pembroke’s on-demand transit hits six months, city invites feedback
item.description: Pembroke’s on-demand transit service, Ottawa River Transit (ORTC), has reached its six-month milestone, and city officials are inviting residents to share their experiences through a service review survey.
